config.notes: Course pages www.canberra.edu.au/course/<UC code>/<version> (static HTML, no page JSON). Intakes: table 'Periods course is open for new admissions' (Year, Location, Teaching period, Teaching start date, Domestic, International); the adapter keeps only the start dates of rows marked 'Open for international admissions' (pick all). Research rows (Research Semester 1/2) carry no date and give no months. IELTS overall: the 'English language requirements' pop-up text (e.g. 'An IELTS Academic score of 6.5 overall, with no band score below 6.0 (or equivalent)'). Duration: 'Course duration' section. Campus (test only): location of the first row of the admissions table. Fees are NOT in the stored HTML (no dollar amounts on course pages; the Fees panel is filled in the browser); https://www.canberra.edu.au/future-students/study-at-uc/fees-and-costs/international-fees-and-costs only says to look up each course. UC College fee table https://www.canberra.edu.au/uc-college/courses/course-fees lists whole-programme fees (not read). Marketing pages /future-students/study-at-uc/about-our-courses/... show domestic-oriented 'Intake dates' and are left to the general reader. Key dates: https://www.canberra.edu.au/about-uc/key-dates/ (PDFs per year); course pages print the teaching period with its start date (2027: Semester 1 15 February, Winter Term 07 June, Semester 2 09 August).
